notes: Network changes are autonomous inside the Cedar envelope (agreed with a cohort lead, see GAPS.md); only changes to the agents themselves need a person. Earlier runs (2026-11-01, 2026-11-02) were approval-based on the replay network; failed and incomplete runs are listed on purpose.

scored_units.swarm_deny: an out-of-range or critical-cell-weakening change is denied by Cedar
scored_units.swarm_autonomous_apply: Cedar allows the change inside the envelope and the network accepts it, with no person in between
scored_units.swarm_verify: the next window is measured; a worse change is undone
scored_units.swarm_stabilization: a second change to the same cell right after is denied
scored_units.swarm_trace: one trace id and contiguous records across the five AgentCore runtimes
scored_units.critical_safe: after the change no critical cell lost QoS
scored_units.problem_to_command: one trace id from the Dynatrace problem to the command sent to Viavi
scored_units.judge: an independent judge (Claude) scores the diagnosis and the fix >= 3/5
scored_units.swarm_pause: after capacity's model is withdrawn its call is refused and the run goes on without it

model_artifact_s3_prefix: none (no model is trained; agents use Bedrock models)

platform.agents: AgentCore Runtime (VPC): track3_orchestrator, track3_coverage, track3_capacity, track3_availability, track3_risk (role team04-track3-runtime, /bb26/ + boundary)
platform.tools: Viavi MCP over HTTP (http://10.0.1.59/mcp, nginx proxy on the team EC2): a read allow-list plus tx_power and antenna_tilt, gated by Cedar through the checkpoint
platform.policy: Cedar policies/swarm.cedar in the checkpoint; the AgentCore Gateway and Policy engine from the earlier design are deployed but no longer used
platform.trigger: Dynatrace workflow 'Track 3 - problem triggers the swarm' -> Lambda track3-trigger (declares targets in S3, one run per incident) -> orchestrator runtime
platform.traces: every run exports to CloudWatch, Dynatrace and Arize; OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=multi-agent-swarm
